name: POTABA
question: Does oral potassium paraaminobenzoate improve plaque or curvature outcomes compared with placebo in early Peyronie's disease?

design.population: Men with Peyronie's disease for less than 12 months, noncalcified plaques, and no pretreatment.
design.locator: PubMed abstract, Purpose and Patients and Methods

verdictNote: Composite response favored POTABA among completers; the prespecified significance threshold was unavailable.
takeaway: Oral potassium paraaminobenzoate improved composite plaque or curvature response versus placebo among 75 completers (74.3% versus 50.0%); the abstract reported no relevant difference in improvement of pre-existing curvature.

reports.label: Primary report
reports.citation: Weidner W, Hauck EW, Schnitker J, et al. "Potassium paraaminobenzoate (POTABA) in the treatment of Peyronie's disease: a prospective, placebo-controlled, randomized study." *Eur Urol.* 2005;47(4):530-536. doi:10.1016/j.eururo.2004.12.022

results.measure: Plaque-size regression and/or at least 30% penile-curvature reduction among completers
results.note: The abstract reports a significant difference but does not state a prespecified alpha or arm-specific completer denominators.
results.locator: PubMed abstract, Patients and Methods and Results

results.measure: Mean plaque area, baseline to 12 months
results.note: Placebo mean increased to 303 mm² at 6 months before declining to 233 mm² at 12 months; P is the reported between-group comparison.
The abstract reports no relevant difference in improvement of pre-existing penile deviation, without arm-specific estimates or curvature angles.

results.measure: New or worsened curvature during treatment
results.note: The abstract reports P<0.001 for placebo deterioration, without an active-arm event rate, arm-specific denominators, or a between-arm estimate for this endpoint.
No significant between-group difference was reported; arm-specific denominators were not given.

harms.label: Severe adverse events
harms.note: The abstract does not provide event counts, other adverse events, or discontinuations by arm.

delivery.label: Oral treatment schedule
delivery.value: Potassium paraaminobenzoate 3 g four times daily (12 g/day) or placebo for 12 months.

delivery.label: Study completion
delivery.value: 75/103 randomized participants completed the study and formed the main valid-case analysis.
